bias_targets.methodology: Computing and averaging the sentiment of sentences containing gender-associated unigrams and bigrams (e.g., male and female pronouns) using SpacyTextBlob.
Computing and averaging the sentiment of sentences containing religion-associated unigrams and bigrams (e.g., proper names of major religions) using SpacyTextBlob.
Computing and averaging the sentiment of sentences containing race-associated unigrams and bigrams (e.g., combinations of racial identifiers and words like man, woman, people) using SpacyTextBlob.
